x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change agenda-item-phase-is-declared (REQ-LIV-010, matrix row age-08). The phase a discussion or decision item is in (forming a picture, forming an opinion, deciding) was written to an undeclared `status` property. It is now the declared, facetable `phase`; MoveAgendaItemStatusToPhase moves existing values once.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Where a discussion or decision item stands: proposal, forming a picture (beeldvorming), forming an opinion (oordeelsvorming), deciding (besluitvorming) or completed. Empty reads as beeldvorming. An informational item has no phase. The chair moves it on the live meeting screen.
